report.title: Re: Lease Renewal Offer and Roofer Inspection
report.summary: Mr. Alan Santos of Santos Property Management is offering a new 12-month lease starting January 1, 2027, with a monthly rent increase to $1,150. The current lease for Unit 4 ends on December 31, 2026, and the tenant must respond by October 20, 2026, to avoid the landlord showing the unit to others. A roofer is scheduled to inspect a hallway leak on October 12, 2026, between 9 am and noon.

sections.heading: Greeting and Opening
sections.body:
Dear Mr. Santos,

Thank you for your letter regarding the renewal of my lease for Unit 4. I am interested in renewing the lease under the new terms you have proposed.

sections.heading: Lease Renewal Terms
sections.body: I would like to proceed with the new 12-month lease starting January 1, 2027, at a monthly rent of $1,150. I understand that the existing deposit of $1,150 will carry over to the new lease. However, could you please confirm if the new lease will include the same deposit amount?

sections.heading: Roofer Inspection Schedule
sections.body: I am aware that a roofer is scheduled to inspect a hallway leak on October 12, 2026, between 9 am and noon. Would it be possible to schedule this inspection in the afternoon instead?

sections.heading: Closing
sections.body: Please let me know if you require any further information from me. I look forward to your confirmation so that I can finalize the renewal before the deadline.
